title: From Seattle: Mount St. Helens and Mount Rainier Private Tour
includes: Scenic drive through Gifford Pinchot National Forest
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning landscapes of the Pacific Northwest on a day trip from Seattle to two iconic landmarks: Mount St. Helens and Mount Rainier National Park. This adventure combines volcanic history with breathtaking mountain vistas, lush forests, and educational insights into the region's natural beauty. Witness the aftermath of the 1980 Mount St. Helens eruption, enjoy scenic viewpoints, and immerse yourself in the tranquility of Gifford Pinchot National Forest. Finish the day at Mount Rainier National Park, where glaciers, waterfalls, and alpine meadows showcase the area's stunning scenery. Perfect for nature lovers, photographers, and anyone eager to appreciate Washington State's wilderness.

- Full-day trip from Seattle to Mount St. Helens and Mount Rainier
- Explore volcanic landscapes and learn about the 1980 eruption
- Experience Gifford Pinchot National Forest's serene beauty
- Enjoy scenic viewpoints, nature walks, and photo opportunities at Mount Rainier
